issues.where: left ring bend and diagonal foreground division
issues.what: The main black division is wider and more hollow at the left bend, then exits noticeably farther right at the bottom. It also loses the faint parallel strands visible inside the target gap.
issues.fix: Match the target's ring projection and gap widths, pull the foreground exit left, and restore the faint parallel strands without lifting the whole gap.

issues.where: lower globe and inner-ring crossing at center-right
issues.what: A broad brown translucent strip cuts across the lit globe and steps down at its left edge. Farther right it drops into a conspicuous black strip. The target has a much thinner bright contact edge that blends into continuous cool gray ring strands.
issues.fix: Remove the stepped brown strip, match the thinner contact line, and carry the shadowed gray ring texture continuously across the crossing.

issues.where: upper-right globe, polar cap and terminator
issues.what: The globe crest sits slightly lower, the upper cap is beige rather than blue-gray, and the broader, softer terminator eats farther into the lower lit face. The target holds a wider pale-yellow face against a more clearly defined diagonal shadow.
issues.fix: Raise the crest slightly, restore the cool upper cap, and shift the lower terminator right while tightening its falloff and retaining a trace of tone on the dark side.

issues.where: crops D, F, G and I, outer ring and lit inner sheet
issues.what: The outer ring is darker, coarser and more mottled, and the inner sheet is warmer and more uniformly striped. The target has more crisp fine ringlets, subtle pink and cool-gray separation, and less rough cross-grain.
issues.fix: Reduce the coarse mottling, brighten the outer midtones selectively, and restore thinner high-frequency strands and restrained alternating warm and cool bands.

issues.where: crops A and C, lit cloud field and upper-left limb
issues.what: The cloud field reads peachier and more granular, with more etched storm outlines near the upper band. The target has broader stacked pale-yellow bands with softer embedded eddies and a less amber limb transition.
issues.fix: Cool and lighten the cream tones, blend the eddies into broader banding, and soften the warm spill just outside the rim.

issues.where: crop B, open sky behind the far rings
issues.what: The sky is more even and fine-speckled, with less of the target's mottled blue dust and fewer warm stars that stand out above the background.
issues.fix: Restore the faint blue cloud structure and a small range of brighter warm and cool stars while preserving deep blacks.

issues.where: crops B, D, F and G, hold ring division and black space beside the lit globe
issues.what: The main ring division reads slightly wider and softer, and there is extra diffuse warm spill into the dark inner cavity beside the left limb. Some of the sharpest strands bordering the gaps are less distinct.
issues.fix: Narrow and sharpen the main division slightly, restore thin edge strands, and confine the warm spill closer to the limb.

issues.where: crops E and H, hold's lower-right shadow and far ring edge
issues.what: The cast-shadow edge and faint ringlets inside the shadow are less defined, and the low blue flare loses the target's secondary warm and muted multicolor streaks.
issues.fix: Match the tighter shadow boundary, bring back faint curved shadow-side strands, and recover the layered low-intensity flare without lifting the black floor.

issues.where: hold's upper pole and upper-right moon
issues.what: The cool blue transition along the planet's upper-right limb is slightly softer, and the moon's lit crescent reads a little more saturated orange and darker toward its tip than the target.
issues.fix: Recover the thin pale-blue limb definition and grade the moon toward the target's lighter, less saturated amber crescent.

issues.where: crops C, H and I, hold's open sky
issues.what: Individual stars have slightly different prominence and the blue dust mottling loses some local separation, especially beyond the right limb and below the left ring.
issues.fix: Match the target's relative star brightness and faint blue-black sky texture without adding a uniform haze.
